deploy._comment_predeploy: One argv, no shell operators. Railway does not evaluate preDeployCommand in a shell: the earlier inline `echo ... && alembic upgrade head && ...` ran only the echo and still passed, so no deploy ever migrated (CB-43). The chain lives in scripts/railway-predeploy.sh; tests/unit/test_release_identity.py pins this.
deploy._comment_healthcheck: Liveness, not readiness. Railway gates a deploy on this path, and /health/ready returns 503 whenever any dependency is unhealthy -- so while the inference provider is down (as it was on 2026-09-27), no deploy could ever pass and a good build could not replace a bad one. Readiness is for a load balancer deciding whether to send traffic; a deploy gate needs to know the process came up. Dependency health is still visible on /health/ready and /metrics.
